about: Hello, I'm Samiran. I'm a project manager who loves organizing chaos and turning big, messy ideas into things that actually ship.

Full Stack .NET Project Manager with 17 years of comprehensive experience driving the development, maintenance, and implementation of complex enterprise systems. Expert in ITIL Best Practices, Incident Management and Service Management Process. A keen strategist with capabilities in delivery management, process compliance, quality, and customer satisfaction.
Outside of work, I plan trips with spreadsheets, host classes, foster animals, and continue learning how thoughtful systems get built.
